subject: PeopleOS Brief — July 09, 2026 Intelligence
preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: Today's PeopleOS Brief highlights significant developments in the tech and economic spheres, with the US stock market showing mixed results driven by tech gains, while global markets experience bullish trends. Notably, Microsoft has replaced OpenAI and Anthropic with its own AI models, indicating a shift in the AI landscape. The global labor market also sees notable trends, with the US labor market characterized by low hire and low fire rates, and tech accounting for nearly a third of layoffs. China has updated its AI policies and expanded access to Nvidia chips, further accelerating global tech innovations.
